sn42.13:1.1: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Koḷiyesu viharati Uttaram nāma Koḷiyānaṃ nigame || || 2
sn42.13:1.2: Atha kho Pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.13:2.1: Ye te bhante evam ahaṃsu Samaṇo Gotamo māyaṃ jānātīti || kacci te bhante Bhagavato vuttavādino na ca Bhagavantam abhūtena abbhācikkhanti || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti || na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgacchati ||
sn42.13:2.3: Ye te gāmaṇi evam āhaṃsu Samaṇo Gotamo māyaṃ jānātīti vuttavādino ceva me te na ca mam abhūtena abbhācikkhanti || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti || na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgacchatīti || || 4
sn42.13:2.4: Saccaṃ yeva kira bho mayam tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ na saddahāma
sn42.13:2.5: Samaṇo Gotamo māyaṃ jānātīti || Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo māyāvīti || ||
sn42.13:2.6: Yo nu kho gāmaṇi evam vadeti Aham māyaṃ jānāmīti so evaṃ vadeti Aham māyāvīti ||
sn42.13:2.7: tatheva tam Bhagavā hoti tatheva tam sugato hotīti || ||
sn42.13:2.8: Tena hi gāmaṇi taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi || yathā te khameyya tathā taṃ vyākareyyāsi || || I (I) 5
sn42.13:3.2: jānāsi tvaṃ gāmaṇi Koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe ti || ||
sn42.13:3.3: Jānāmaham bhante Koḷiyānaṃ lambacūlake bhaṭe ti || || 6
sn42.13:3.4: Taṃ kim maññasi gāmaṇi || kim atthiyā Koliyānaṃ lambacūlakā bhaṭāti || ||
sn42.13:3.5: Ye ca bhante Koḷiyānaṃ corā te ca paṭisedhetuṃ yāni ca Koḷiyānam duteyyāni tāni vahātuṃ etadatthiyā bhante Koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭāti || 7
sn42.13:3.7: jānāsi tvaṃ Koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe || silavanto vā te dussīlā vā ti || ||
sn42.13:3.8: Jānāmaham bhante Koḷiyānaṃ lambacūlake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme || ye ca loke dussilā pāpadhammā Koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷakā tesam aññatarāti || || 8
sn42.13:3.9: Yo nu kho gāmaṇi evam vadeyya || ||
sn42.13:3.10: Pātaliyo gāmaṇi jānāti Koḷiyānam lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme || Pāṭaliyo pi gāmaṇi dussīlo pāpadhammoti || sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyya || ||
sn42.13:3.12: aññe bhante Koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā añño hamasmi aññathādhammā Koḷiyānam lambacūḷakā bhaṭā aññathādhammo hamasmīti || || 9 Tvaṃ
sn42.13:3.13: hi nāma gāmaṇi lacchasi Pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi jānāti Koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme na ca Pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi dussīlo pāpadhammoti || kasmā tathāgato na lacchati Tathāgato māyaṃ jānāti na ca tathāgato māyāvīti || ||
sn42.13:3.14: Māyañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi || māyāya ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca māyāvī kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 10
sn42.13:4.1: Paṇātipātañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi pāṇātipātassa ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca pāṇātipātā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || 11
sn42.13:4.2: Adinnādānañcāham gāmaṇi pajānāmi || adinnādānassa ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca adinnādāyī kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 12
sn42.13:4.3: Kāmesu micchācārañ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi kāmesu micchācārassa ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca kāmesu micchācārī kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātam nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 13
sn42.13:4.4: Musāvādañcāham gāmaṇi pajānāmi || musāvādassa ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca musāvādī kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatim vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 14
sn42.13:4.5: Pisuṇavācañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pijānāmi pasuṇavācāya ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca pisunavāco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || 15
sn42.13:4.6: Pharusavācañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi pharusavācāya ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca pharusavāco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatim vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 16
sn42.13:4.7: Samphappalāpañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi samphappalāpassa ca vipākam || yathāpaṭipanno ca samphappalāpī kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 17
sn42.13:4.8: Abhijjhañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi abhijjhāya ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca abhijjhālu kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 18
sn42.13:4.9: Vyāpādapadosañcāham gāmani pajānāmi vyāpādapadosassa ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca vyāpannacitto kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātam nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 19
sn42.13:4.10: Micchādiṭṭhiñcāham gāmaṇi pajānāmi micchādiṭṭhiyā ca vipākaṃ || yathāpaṭipanno ca micchādiṭṭhiko kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati tañca pajānāmi || || 20
sn42.13:5.1: Santi gāmaṇi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evam diṭṭhino
sn42.13:5.2: Yo koci pāṇam atimāpeti sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassam paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn42.13:5.3: yo koci adinnam ādiyati sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassam paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn42.13:5.4: yo koci kāmesu micchācarati sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassam paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn42.13:5.5: yo koci musā bhaṇati sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassam paṭisaṃvediyatīti || || (I) 21
sn42.13:6.1: Dissati kho pana gāmani idhekacco mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikamehi rājāmaññe paricārento ||
sn42.13:6.3: Ambho ayam puriso kim akāsi mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājāmaññe paricāretīti ||
sn42.13:6.5: ambho puriso rañño paccatthikam pasayha jīvitā voropesi ||
sn42.13:6.7: tenāyam puriso mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājāmaññe paricāretīti || 22
sn42.13:7.1: Dissati kho pana gāmaṇi idhekacco daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanam bandhitvā khuramuṇḍam karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakam pariṇetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetva dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chijjamāno ||
sn42.13:7.3: Ambho ayam puriso kim akāsi daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gaḷhabandhanam bandhitvā khuramuṇḍam karitvā kharasarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyam siṅghātakena siṅghāṭakam parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsam chindatīti ||
sn42.13:7.5: Ambho ayam puriso rājaverī itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā jīvitā voropesi ||
sn42.13:7.6: tena naṃ rājāno gahetvā evarūpaṃ kammakaraṇaṃ karontīti || || 23
sn42.13:8.2: api nu te evarūpaṃ diṭṭham vā sutaṃ vā ti || ||
sn42.13:8.3: Diṭṭhañca no bhante sutañca sūyissati cā ti || || 24
sn42.13:8.4: Tatra gāmaṇi ye te samaṇabrahmanā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
sn42.13:8.5: Yo koci pāṇam atimāpeti sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassam paṭisaṃvediyatīti || saccaṃ vā te āhaṃsu musā vā ti || ||
sn42.13:8.7: Ye pana te tucchaṃ musā vilapanti sīlavanto vā te dussīlā vā ti || ||
sn42.13:8.9: Ye pana te dussīlā pāpadhammā micchāpaṭipannā vā te sammāpaṭipannā vā ti || ||
sn42.13:8.11: Ye pana te micchāpaṭipannā micchādiṭṭhikā vā te sammādiṭṭhikā vā ti || ||
sn42.13:8.13: Ye pana te micchādiṭṭhikā kallaṃ nu tesu pasīditun ti || ||

sn42.13:16.2: Natthi dinnam natthi yiṭṭhaṃ natthi hutaṃ natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānam kammānam phalaṃ vipāko || natthi ayaṃ loko natthi paraloko natthi mātā natthi pitā natthi sattā opapātikā || natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokam paraṃ ca lokaṃ sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti || || 39

sn42.13:18.2: Karato kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācayato socato socayato kilamato kilamayato phandato phandāpayato pāṇam atimāpayato adinnam ādiyato sandhim chindato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikam karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato paradāraṃ gacchato musā bhaṇato karato na karīyati pāpaṃ || ||
sn42.13:18.3: Khurapariyantena ce pi cakkena imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekam maṃsakhalam ekam maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya || natthi tato nidānam pāpaṃ natthi pāpassa āgamo || ||
sn42.13:18.4: Dakkhiṇañ ce pi Gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento natthi tato nidānam pāpam natthi pāpussa āgamo || ||
sn42.13:18.5: Uttarañce pi Gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yajāpento natthi tato nidānam puññam natthi puññassa āgamo ||
sn42.13:18.6: dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññam natthi puññassa āgamo ti || || 41
sn42.13:19.2: Karato kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācayato socato socapāyato kilamato kilamāpayato phandato phandāpayato pāṇam atimāpayato adinnam ādiyato sandhiṃ chidato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikaṃ karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato paradāraṃ gacchato musā bhaṇato karato kāriyati pāpam || ||
sn42.13:19.3: Khurapariyantena ce pi cakkena imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekam maṃsakhalam ekam maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya || atthi tato nidānam pāpam atthi pāpassa āgamo || ||
sn42.13:19.4: Dakkhiṇañ ce pi Gaṅgāya tīram gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento atthi tato nidānam pāpam atthi pāpassa āgamo || ||
sn42.13:19.5: Uttarañ ce pi Gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yājento atthi tato nidānam puññaṃ || atthi puññassa āgamo ||
sn42.13:19.6: dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena atthi puññam atthi puññassa āgamoti || || 42
sn42.13:20.1: Tassa mayham bhante ahudeva kaṅkhā ahu vicikicchā ||
sn42.13:20.2: Ko su nāma imesam bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccam āha ko musā ti || || Alaṃ
sn42.13:21.1: hi te gāmaṇi kaṅkhitum alaṃ vicikicchituṃ ||
sn42.13:21.2: kaṅkhaniye ca pana te ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā ti || ||
sn42.13:21.3: Evam pasanno ham bhante Bhagavati || pahoti me Bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāham imam kaṅkhādhammam pajaheyyanti || || 43

sn42.13:22.4: (I) 44 Idha gāmaṇi ariyasāvako pāṇātipātam pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti || adinnādānam pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti || kāmesu micchācāram pahāya kāmesu micchācārāpaṭivirato hoti || musāvādam pahāya musāvādā pativirato hoti || pisuṇaṃ vācam pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti || pharusaṃ vācam pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti || samphappalāpam pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti || abhijjham pahāya anabhijjhālu hoti || vyāpādadosam pahāya avyāpannacitto hoti || micchādiṭṭhim pahāya sammādiṭṭhiko hoti || ||
